helpTitle: Buying, selling and the CHF 30 reservation
helpIntro: Understand the checks, auction rules and payment steps before you list a vehicle or make a binding bid.
helpScope: The vehicle purchase price is paid separately between buyer and seller. The CHF 30 reservation covers the platform process; AutoVeri does not hold the vehicle purchase price in escrow.
helpVerificationText: Phone verification confirms access to a phone number. Identity review is a separate step. A verified private-seller badge identifies an account reviewed as a private seller. Listing review and OCR suggestions are not a mechanical inspection, proof of ownership or a guarantee of vehicle condition. Inspect the vehicle and its original documents before handover.
helpAuctionText: An approved auction runs for seven days from approval. An accepted bid in the final three minutes extends the current deadline by two minutes. Bidding closes at the updated deadline. A sale requires a qualifying winning bid that meets any hidden reserve. A fixed-price listing instead uses offers that the seller can accept or reject.
helpHoldText: A confirmed CHF 30 authorization is required before a bid or offer is accepted. A reservation is not a completed charge. The payment provider sets its expiry; it is not guaranteed to last seven days. If necessary, the buyer renews the authorization from the dashboard. The card method shown in checkout is supported; TWINT and Datatrans are not currently integrated.
helpReleaseText: When you are outbid, or a sale is cancelled before capture, the platform requests release of the eligible reservation. A request is not the same as confirmation: the dashboard shows a pending release until processing succeeds. Your bank determines when the reserved amount becomes available. Auctions with no qualifying winner release remaining reservations.
helpSettlementText: Buyer and seller arrange vehicle payment and handover separately. After both are complete, the seller confirms the sale. The platform then requests capture of CHF 30 from the winning buyer’s reservation as its fee. A completed status is shown only after confirmed capture; an expired authorization may require renewal and review.
helpDisputeText: Buyer or seller can open a case from Sale settlements. Open cases pause pending captures. A seller’s default report does not automatically charge the buyer; an independent admin reviews it. After approval, CHF 30 is a service fee retained by the platform operator, not compensation paid to the seller. A refund-required decision does not execute a refund; an actual refund needs a separate operator process. Do not enter identity or card data in case notes.

Local test payments simulate reservations and captures without moving real money and are available only in the restricted local development mode. They do not establish that live payment or SMS services have been activated.
helpNotTerms: This page explains the current application behaviour. It is not a vehicle warranty, a buyer-protection insurance policy or a replacement for the platform’s contractual terms.

proxyNotice: LOCAL DESIGN PROPOSAL — synthetic A/B bidders only. No real bid, reservation or payment. Both maximum amounts are visible here for learning; nothing is saved.
proxyRules: A bids at 0 seconds; the original end is 600 seconds. First bid pays the starting price. The higher maximum wins at the lower maximum plus one increment, capped by the winner’s maximum. Equal maxima favour the earlier accepted limit. A new challenger must meet the current price plus the increment.
proxyHoldRule: Virtual CHF 30 reservation: keep the leader’s hold, release the loser’s. Within the last 180 seconds, a competitive command adds 120 seconds once. Raising only the leader’s limit changes neither price nor time. Expired holds stop the simulation; renewal is not simulated.
proxyInvalid: Use positive CHF values with a decimal point and at most two decimals; remaining seconds must be 0–600.
proxyTooLow: The maximum does not reach the required next bid.
proxyHoldExpired: The leader’s reservation needs renewal; no automatic replacement winner.
proxyRaiseOnly: The leader may only raise its maximum.

pgEvidenceError: Evidence is missing, hidden, unrelated or inaccessible.
pgStale: The record or evidence changed. Refresh and submit updated evidence for another review.
pgLegacyDisabled: The old single-review action is disabled. Use independent review.
pgForbidden: Admin permission is missing or changed.
pgNotice: Local mode: evidence is required and a different eligible admin must approve release. Automatic links or uncertainty block release. No retention periods are inferred and no data is deleted.
rhAssignmentNotice: Taking ownership coordinates work only. It does not grant approval rights; a different eligible admin must decide.
rhNoticeReview: A protection review needs an independent admin assessment. Open the request for its current status.
rhNoticeInfo: Additional evidence was requested for your protection review. Protection remains active.
rhNoticeKept: The review concluded that protection must remain active.
rhNoticeReleased: The manual protection was released after independent review. No data was deleted.
rhNoticeWithdrawn: The protection review request was withdrawn. Protection remains active.
rhTarget: Showing the linked review request and its current state.
rhNoReviewer: No eligible second admin is available. The request remains in the queue; no exception or automatic approval is applied.
spIntro: Send your question here and follow replies and status updates. Do not include passwords, payment card data or identity documents.
spClosedHint: This request is closed. Contact support in a new request if needed.
spFailed: The request could not be completed. Refresh and try again.
spConflict: This request changed. Refresh before sending again.
spLimit: Request limit reached. Try later or use an existing request.
srUnavailable: Previous admin is no longer eligible
srReadPage: Mark replies on this page as read
srAssignmentHint: Assignment coordinates work. Other eligible admins can still respond.
srRecent: The latest 20 assignment changes are shown.
srNoticeReply: Support has replied or updated your request. Open it to see the current status.
srNoticeActivity: A support request needs attention. Open it to see the latest messages.
srNoticeAssignment: The responsible admin for a support request has changed. Open it for the current assignment.
sqHint: Subject text is matched without case sensitivity. A full request ID is matched exactly. Message contents are not searched.
spUnsavedLeave: You have an unsent message or an unsaved assignment reason. Leave this page and discard these inputs?
scPreserved: Another update was saved. Your message, assignment reason and selections are preserved. Load and review the current request before submitting again.
scNoAutoSend: Nothing is sent automatically. Check the current status and responsible admin against your selections, then submit explicitly.
scRecent: Review view: the latest 30 messages, oldest first. Assignment history and current request details are shown above.
shHint: Your unsent reply, assignment reason and selections stay in the editor. Browsing does not mark messages as read or approve a conflict review.
hsUTC: Dates include the whole day in UTC.
hsInvalid: Enter valid dates with the start on or before the end.
mlAccess: This link grants no access. Sign in with an account authorized to view this request.
mlUnavailable: The message is unavailable, access is not permitted, or loading failed.
rfHint: Request a review of the platform service fee. Vehicle payments are not handled here.
rfNoMoney: Approval is a review decision, not a completed refund. This screen does not send money.
rfConflict: The request changed. Your text is retained. Reload and review the current version before submitting again.
rfPolicy: Review is unavailable: policy is incomplete, your decision is already recorded, or this case is not open for review.
rfDenied: Sign in with an account authorized to view this request.
rfInvalid: Select a payment and enter a reason of 20–2000 characters.
rfRate: Too many requests. Try again later.
rfUnavailable: Refund service is unavailable or the payment link needs review. No payment has been initiated by this screen.
rfReasonHelp: 20–2000 characters. Do not include passwords, card details or identity documents.
rcScope: Local database consistency only. Provider statements, bank balances, fees, payouts and chargebacks are not verified.
rcReadOnly: Read only: no payment, correction or deletion is performed. Unknown policies and retention periods remain open.
rcPageTotals: Totals cover only this page, in CHF, separated by test/live environment. They are not net revenue or bank balances.
rcIncomplete: Some records are invalid and excluded from totals. The report is incomplete.
rcEmpty: No capture records on this page. This does not prove provider completeness.
rcMatched: No difference detected among the local records checked.
rcDenied: Active admin status and explicit payment reconciliation permission are required.
rcIDENTITY: Capture identity, scope or version mismatch.
rcCOMMAND_MISSING: Snapshot operation has no command record.
rcRECEIPT_CONFLICT: Receipt disagrees with the operation, amount, currency or scope.
rcDUPLICATE: Duplicate operation key or refund reference.
rcAUDIT: Latest audit record is missing or disagrees with the snapshot.
rcBUDGET: Refunds or reservations exceed the capture.
rcUNRESOLVED: Provider outcome is pending or unknown; no time threshold assumed.
rcREVIEW: Unconfirmed capture or existing review/block flag.
rfApprovedPolicy: Full refund without deducting provider fees. Two independent approvals; an authorised approver may execute.
rfTimingPolicy: Targets: first response in 2 business days; decision within 5 business days after sufficient information; update every 5 business days. Working/holiday calendar is undecided; no fixed deadlines or bank timing guarantee.
rfInformationReminder: Response target passed. Still awaiting information; no automatic rejection.
rfBlocked: Payment blocked. A dispute or discrepancy needs review.
rfEvidenceRequired: Confirm checked transaction/platform evidence with its reference and reasoning. A screenshot alone is insufficient.
rfReopenRequired: Open the rejected request to request another review.
rfReviewLimit: The same-evidence review has already been used. Significant new evidence or transaction errors may still be reviewed.
rfDifferentReviewer: A different authorised administrator is required.
rfEquivalent: One review with the same evidence
rfNoticeUpdate: Your refund request has been updated. See the refunds area.
rfPublicReason: This explanation is visible to the requester. Do not include internal notes or third-party personal data.
rfOpsTargets: Operational targets: daily reconciliation and escalation of critical discrepancies on the same business day. Responsible people and working calendar are not configured. No automatic correction or confirmed alert delivery.
